prompts: Use case: editorial-illustration. Create a wide landscape editorial cover for TrackMyOPT's article on the proposed removal of the H-1B 60-day layoff grace period. A fictional South Asian software professional at a home desk reviewing a calendar, employment letter, and two possible paths represented by simple arrows. Calm, practical, thoughtful mood; sophisticated illustrated paper texture, navy and emerald accents, warm cream background, accessible and human. No words, numbers, logos, government seals, watermarks, or implication the proposal is already law. Keep all important content in the central 1200:630 crop.
